answer: The presser crushes his olives in the screw press, and the oil must run clear or the soap turns rancid. The karst is the first crush, made at the press; the anchor is the last, made before the olives run out, and the mirror is the press itself, groaning with every turn. A cheat must crush 53 false loads and turn 53 false screws.
